$comment: The actions that need the confirmation step, mirroring the list of agent-safety: Actions that need the confirmation step, one item per bullet of the spec, in its order. Each action names the task that builds it until that task does; then it names its confirm command and an input its two cases run with (a session and a CSRF token alone get 403; a nonce for another action gets 403). pnpm check:confirmations checks this file.

items.item: confirming a proposal, which is how a commitment takes effect, and undoing a commitment within its undo window, as the requests capability defines who may do each and when;

actions.action: undoing a commitment within its undo window

items.item: changing a member's role, removing a member, and creating an invite;
connecting a GitHub installation, uploading a new private key for the install's GitHub App, and connecting or changing the Jira connection;

actions.action: uploading a new private key for the install's GitHub App

items.item: registering an API for contract reports;

actions.action: registering an API for contract reports

items.item: turning personal access tokens on or off, setting the longest lifetime a personal access token may have, and setting the daily write budget;

actions.action: turning personal access tokens on or off
setting the longest lifetime a personal access token may have

items.item: approving an agent client on the consent screen or on the device approval page;

actions.action: approving an agent client on the consent screen
approving an agent client on the device approval page

items.item: confirming a contract-change fan-out to more than 10 consumer teams;

actions.action: confirming a contract-change fan-out to more than 10 consumer teams
